notes: _ROGet@8 (128 B = 121 code + 7-B census pad 8da42400000000). Recipe: declare the returned slot as `unsigned long w` (NOT ushort) so `w = *(unsigned short *)r` loads xor eax/eax + mov ax,[edx] (32-bit zero-extended view) and objPtrs[w] sibs via EAX (8b 1c 85) with NO mask copy; w must be DEAD after the sib (return = `*(unsigned short *)r` re-deref, NOT the variable) which frees EAX so the currentTime load emits 66 a1 moffs AX-cache and the flag param reads mov al,[esp+0x10] (clobbering ax, then the found path reloads mov ax,[edx] before ret 8). Loop = do{...}while(r < _ro+0x6d6) with the xor eax reload inside the loop head (jb loops back to the xor); mask test = *(long *)((char *)objPtrs[w] + 1) & 1 (test [ebx+1],ecx with mov ecx,1 hoisted before the loop, reusing the dead ?SC_uf4+0x4 limit reg). FA's dead ebp save (55 prolog / 5d pops) is reproduced by CL itself for free (w32-dead spelling) — no patch needed. Alternative spellings w42B_roget_v6/v7/v8 (scalar ct extern / declared op local) also EXACT byte-identical; v5 kept as winner (2 maps only). No 0= aliases: FA's 3 e8 callers into ROGet (@EJECTAdd@4 @0x68b7b, _MANAdd@24 @0x7bd8b, _PROJAdd@40 @0xbceaa) are rel32 self-resolvers, and 0 data VA references exist.

?pkt_build_new_player (112 B incl 11-B census pad 8d642400+8da42400000000). Recipe: after pkt_set_header(-1, pkt, 3) and the word store *(ushort*)(pkt+4)=id, write the 14-byte NET_ADDRESS copy through a declared cursor local `char *d = pkt + 6` with four offset stores *(ulong*)d / *(ulong*)(d+4) / *(ulong*)(d+8) / *(ushort*)(d+0xc) — CL then materializes lea edx,[ebx+0x6] once and stores through [edx+0/4/8/0xc] with scratch rotation dword0=eax (8b 01/89 02), dword1=ebp (8b 69 04/89 6a 04), dword2=esi (8b 71 08/89 72 08), word=ax (66 8b 41 0c/66 89 42 0c). strcpy intrinsic tail: mov edi,[esp+0x1c] hoisted between dword0/1 stores; count staged via mov edx,ecx (8b d1) and reloaded mov ecx,edx (8b ca); 5d pop ebp scheduled between the reload and and ecx,3 (matches FA). No strcpy symbol reference emitted (fully inlined) — only map needed = _pkt_set_header.
?pkt_build_lost_player — byte twin of pktnew_v2 with header type 0x15 (6a 15). Same cursor + scratch-rotation recipe.

_CTEval_tgtaspectangle (160 B). CTEval_tgtfacing (wave-26c) gate structure + 16-bit idiv recipe (q=0xb6 / 0f bf c0 movsx). KEY lever: locals esp-slot assignment — v1 with decls (t0, t1, q, m) put CL's t0 at [esp+2] (FA wants t0 at [esp+0]); declaring t1 FIRST (v2: t1, t0, q, m) flips the two &t-slot leas and every [esp]<>[esp+2] access to FA's assignment — 10 single-byte diffs all vanished. Map spellings = w26c family (svcGate/svcTick/curThing11 + _AnglesOffNoseQ@16 + @AbsQ@4 fastcall bare form).

_CTDo_movetoalt (128 B = 125 code + 3-B census pad 8d4900). C shape: a=(ushort)f00(); b=c90<<8; signed-long clamp if(u1>_ctt+0x75 max)/else if(u2<... min) via *(long*)(curThingType+0x75/0x79); d=(ushort)fc0(); e=fa0(); gate serviceTicks[0xec] return; MVRMoveToAlt stdcall 6 args with shorts pushed raw; then word-zero stores st+0x100 and st+0xfc (66 c7 05), mov eax,1 + byte stores st+0xf0/st+0xf8 (a2). Signedness of the clamp decls (long u1/u2/b) is REQUIRED for FA's jg(7f)/jge(7d) — unsigned gives CL ja(77)/jae(73). CL's saved-pool assignment stayed by touch order (a,b,d) -> (esi,edi,ebx) regardless of decl order (v2 tried decls (a,d,b,e)) and the cmp orientation canonicalizes reg-first (cmp b,u1 / jl / jle) while FA has load-first (cmp u1,b / jg / jge) — the w38D _CTDo_move sibling precedent: reg color + orientation not steerable, patch the band. Patches below are pure byte-swaps (no length change, no fixup touched). ANCHOR LIVENESS: maps TO $FA$_t_464f00 (kept alive by w41D_64f00_v2's converter alias 0=$FA$_t_464f00), $FA$_t_464c90, $FA$_t_464fa0, $FA$_t_464fc0 (chunks 0x464c90/464fa0/464fc0 still stubs today; if a parallel batch converts one it must carry its own 0=$FA$_t_<hex> alias). No 0= alias needed for mtalt itself: 0 data VA references.
